## 3.1.2 Synthetic measurements

The forward solution is generated with a time step of dt undersampled in time to 15ms, leading to a total of 56 measurements. From the solution of the forward problem; we simulate a PC-MRI acquisition by subsampling into a rectangular measurement resolution of [2mm, 2mm, 2mm] and then applying the process described in Section 2.1 with a venc of double the maximal velocity.
